Congress moves privilege motion against minister over 'no firing' claim

Congress MP K.C. Venugopal submitted a privilege motion notice against Union Minister Jitendra Singh. The motion alleges that Singh knowingly and deliberately misled Parliament by claiming 'no shots were fired' during a protest. Left-leaning outlets highlighted the claim of misleading Parliament, while centrist coverage focused on the privilege motion being filed.
